limits: Queue was empty during the final browser run; queued/leased/expired/superseded rows and multi-page ordering were verified in UI tests and isolated PostgreSQL tests.
This is additive Control verification. Historical fault/restart/default-journey/home-card receipts and hashes remain unchanged; no full requalification is claimed.
A cold knowledge read has per-exchange time bounds without an aggregate deadline. Browser graph assertion waits up to 35s for actual entities; this is not a latency performance qualification.
Work view refresh is manual and displays read snapshot timestamps. An occupied lease slot is not proof of an active model process.
No execution controls, PR merge, published OCI release, HA or production activation.
